title: Design: Modern estimate without a unit drops Unit from the band
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B with an asset that has year, make and model but no unit (for example 2017 Ford Transit).
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B on that asset, billed to customer A.
  • Set the document design to modern (Settings, invoice and estimate design).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p4-06-after-modern.png, bt-p4-05-before-modern.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Finance tab shows the estimate.

Step 2:

  • The BILL TO box names customer A with address and phone.
  • The band reads "SERVICE FOR", customer B's name, " · ", then year, make and model: no "Unit" and no extra separator.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-R2: “On a work order with an asset, the band adds "Unit [unit]" and "[year] [make] [model]", separated by " · ".”
  • S8-R3: “Missing unit, year, make or model parts drop out with their separator; a unit already starting with "Unit" is not prefixed again.”
  • S8-R6: “The band prints on the modern and legacy layouts, invoice and estimate, part sale invoice and batch invoice.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "4 Service For band on invoices and estimates", pictures "Modern" (This build), "Modern" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p4-06-after-modern.png
  • bt-p4-05-before-modern.png

The design's own words:

  • “The asset has no unit, so "Unit" drops out with its separator.”
